verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform supports building bots (with bot tokens) that join servers/channels as members and use the Gateway API to receive real-time events (e.g., message creation) which could include mention-based triggers — a common bot pattern. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a 'respond when @mentioned' feature or AI-agent-specific integration, so this relies on general bot/Gateway capabilities rather than a dedicated AI-agent-membership feature.
